title: Protean ChangePlan v0.1.0
description: A serializable, previewable description of a change: an ordered list of operations (create a file, edit a file, patch config) that a command like `add` or an upgrade would apply.

plan_version.description: Semantic version of the ChangePlan format. Pinned so a plan written for a different version fails validation here instead of being read against the wrong schema.

description.description: Optional human-readable summary of the plan

operations.description: The operations to apply, in order; position is semantic

create_operation.description: Create a new file carrying its whole content

path.description: Target path of the file to create

content.description: Full content of the new file

ownership.description: The generation-gap seam (ADR-0035): 'generated' for a file the generator owns and may refresh on a re-run of add, 'hand_owned' for a file the developer owns that a re-run must never overwrite. Optional; defaults to 'hand_owned'.

edit_operation.description: Edit an existing file, carried as a unified-diff string

path.description: Target path of the file to edit

config_operation.description: A structured set/merge over a key path in domain.toml (never a text diff)

key_path.description: Ordered key segments identifying the target, e.g. ["databases", "default", "provider"]

value.description: The JSON value to set or merge

operation.description: Whether to set (replace) or merge the value; optional, defaults to set
